But seemly is about social norms, could be authority (tradition) or purity (proper). I think purity (decen*, 09). Also note: inappropriate opposite. So purity=1. Also maybe general? But better purity.

421: foodie :: unenthusiastic about food - no moral relevance. 0 all.

422: chill :: sassy - chill (calm) vs sassy (bold, sharp). Not moral. 0 all.

423: glamorous :: spartan - glamorous (luxurious) vs spartan (simple). Spartan could relate to purity (austerity, self-discipline)? Purity includes austerity. So purity=1 for spartan? Or both? Glamorous is opposite of simple, not directly immoral. But spartan suggests discipline. So purity=1. Note: spartan aligns with purity virtue (austerity, self-discipline).
